title: jobs
description: Consumer contract for Delta table stage2_queue, the Stage 2 work items (crawl jobs). Not a medallion gold table. Scout rows gain url_hash in QueueItemPipeline via _canonical_queue_row before the write. SeedManager writes url_hash itself. Consumers must ignore unknown properties such as parent_url, content_hint, priority, queued_by, discovery_source, target_stage, and enqueued_at.

url.description: Canonical URL when the row passed through _canonical_queue_row. Seed rows store the URL SeedManager already hashed.

url_hash.description: Merge key. Set by SeedManager, or by _canonical_queue_row before a scout handoff is written.

status.description: Enqueue writes pending. Stage 2 later sets completed or failed. The table is unpartitioned so status can change in place.

is_heavy.description: Declared on the PyArrow registry. Not set by the scout or seed enqueue writers.

queued_at.description: ISO-8601 time on the scout handoff. SeedManager writes enqueued_at instead, which is not part of this contract. The PyArrow registry declares timestamp(ms); writes infer the column from the batch.

started_at.description: Declared on the PyArrow registry. Not set by the enqueue writers.

completed_at.description: Declared on the PyArrow registry. Not set by the enqueue writers.

retry_count.description: Declared on the PyArrow registry. Not set by the enqueue writers.
